dedupe_keys.name: luigi maps of ecosystem multifunctionality and ecological connectivity for green infrastructure in the european alps

description: This dataset gives 20 m raster maps of ecological connectivity and ecosystem multifunctionality for identifying green infrastructure networks in ten pilot regions of the European Alps. Thomas Marsoner, Heidi Simion, Valentina Giombini and Lukas Egarter Vigl of Eurac Research produced it in the LUIGI Interreg Alpine Space project and released version 1 on Zenodo in June 2022. It contains an ecological network layer, a landscape permeability layer and an ecosystem-service-based multifunctionality layer. Pilot regions are Isère, Savoie and Haute-Savoie in France, the Munich metropolitan region, central Salzburg and South Burgenland in Austria, the Goriška region in Slovenia, South Tyrol, the metropolitan cities of Milan and Turin, and the canton of Grisons. Format and access: three ZIP archives (about 540 MB) on Zenodo. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: results are model outputs for pilot regions, not the whole Alps. It supports planning of green infrastructure corridors alongside transport and energy networks and climate adaptation. Related catalogue records are the JRC and EEA strategic green infrastructure report and the Natural England green infrastructure mapping database.
